# Project Overview

This document describes the goals of the platform initiative for the coming
quarter. Our primary aim is to improve reliability while reducing the overall
operating cost of the service.

The team has agreed on three main priorities. First, we will consolidate the
duplicated data pipelines that have grown over the past year. Second, we intend
to document the existing interfaces so that new engineers can onboard quickly.
Finally, we will invest in better observability across the fleet.

Each of these workstreams will be reviewed at the end of the quarter. Progress
should be reported weekly during the regular team meeting.
